pathforge_fit_adaptation: The outside user need is high demand for article/content optimization. This lane adapts that demand into a deterministic offline browser triage wheel where someone pastes a title and rough notes, marks freshness/source/FAQ/date gaps, sees a visible risk result, and copies/downloads a rewrite brief. It does not generate the article, call hosted AI, use external APIs, load CDN assets, use remote fonts, require logins, or create a multi-file bundle.
